_note: Habitat synergies in Draft Duel. A bonus turns on when a herd has `tiers` different animals of a habitat (copies of the same animal count once), and gets stronger at each tier: `values` are per tier, in the order of `tiers`. Every bonus applies to that habitat's own animals, except City (Acorns for the player). `text` is shown to players; {v} is replaced by the tier's value. `effect` picks what the battle engine does: attack_speed (% faster attacks), regen (% of health healed each second), shield (% of health as a shield at the start of a fight), slow_on_hit (% slow on the enemy hit, for `seconds`), damage_reduction (% less damage taken), damage (% harder hits), health (% more health), speed (% faster movement) or acorns (bonus Acorns at the start of each round).

habitats.name: Rainforest
habitats.text: Rainforest animals heal {v}% of their health every second.

habitats.name: Ocean
habitats.text: Ocean animals start each fight with a shield worth {v}% of their health.

habitats.name: Arctic
habitats.text: Arctic animals' hits slow enemies by {v}% for 2 seconds.

habitats.name: City
habitats.text: You get +{v} bonus Acorns at the start of each round.
